entry.summary: The Model Context Protocol (MCP) allows LLMs in Claude Desktop, Cursor, and agent frameworks to run tools, query databases, and read local files. entry.title: How to Stop a Model Picking the Wrong Fact From a Long Prompt
entry.summary: Engineer's view. This is a search ranking bug. Your site search returns the page that matches the query's words best, even when that page is out of date. A model reading a long prompt does the same thing. A passage that echoes your question can beat the true one. Every extra chunk you send adds rivals. TL;DR. A model reading a long prompt favors the passage that best matches your question, true or not. Long prompts hurt mostly because they carry more look-alikes, so keep those out and ask questions only the right passage answers. You lost a blue umbrella, so you go to the lost-and-found desk.
